## On ownership

Every record in this registry is `UNOWNED`, and nothing above assigns an owner.
That is deliberate and it is not an oversight to be tidied up by a script.

Commit history answers "who typed the most here", which is routinely not the person
accountable for whether a simulation is good, whether it should exist, or whether it
is ready for students. Putting a name against work from a `git log` would manufacture
an accountability that nobody agreed to, and it would look authoritative while being
wrong. Group 6 therefore stops at naming the decision.
